 [ "$math" = fast ] || binary="$binary-conservative"

  grep '^ROUTER_TILES cases=72 bits_and_guards=BIT_EXACT PASS$' "$last_log".*.0

echo ROUTER_TILES_NATIVE_PASS
python3 "$logs/gate-native-v2.py"

python3 "$logs/campaign-v3.py"

import datetime, hashlib, json, os, re, statistics, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd(); logs = root / 'tmp/strata-router-eight-20261004'; out = logs / 'results-model'
candidate = root / 'a64fx/glm5/build/candidate-router-tiles-eight-v3'
frozen = root / 'a64fx/glm5/build/candidate-capacity4096-v1'
score_v3 = root / 'a64fx/glm5/build/candidate-mla-logits-v3'
guard = datetime.datetime(2026,10,4,10,45,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp()
assert os.environ.get('PJM_JOBID') == '52159552'
options = ['--decode-executor','persistent','--router-kernel','fused','--verify-kernel','grouped',
 '--moe-combine-kernel','vector','--index-kernel','heads','--mla-kernel','fp16-cache',
 '--pool-selector','partition4k','--q8-row-kernel','rows4','--q8-prefill-kernel','tile4x4',
 '--mla-projection-kernel','legacy']
summary = {'status':'running','promoted':False,'targets_met':False,'allocation':52159552,
 'prefill_includes_mtp_teacher_forcing':True,'screens':{},'confirmation':[], 'native_gates':True}
summary['binary_sha256'] = {name:hashlib.sha256((directory/'bench_glm53f_run_12n').read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name,directory in [('frozen',frozen),('candidate',candidate),('score_v3',score_v3)]}
def save():
 (out/'performance.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(label, variant=None, prompt='tmp/prompt8k.ids', transitions=256, repetitions=3, state=False, baseline=False, packed=False):
 if time.time()+600>guard:
  summary['status']='deferred_allocation_limit';save();raise SystemExit(75)
 directory=frozen if baseline is True else score_v3 if baseline == 'score-v3' else candidate
 argv=['bash','a64fx/glm5/run_glm53f_12n.sh','benchmark',prompt,str(out/(label+'.ids')),
       '--prefill-chunk','4096','--transitions',str(transitions),'--repetitions',str(repetitions)]+options
 if baseline is not True: argv+=['--embedding-batch-kernel','packed' if packed else 'legacy','--verify-head-kernel','shared' if variant and variant.get('shared') else 'legacy']
 if baseline is not True:
  argv+=['--mla-logits-kernel','legacy','--mla-prefill-heads','split6' if variant and variant.get('split6') else 'legacy']
 if not baseline:
  argv+=['--moe-router-prefill',selected['option'] if variant and variant.get('router_tiles') else 'legacy']
  argv+=['--mla-value-kernel','normalized2' if variant and variant.get('values') else 'legacy']
 if variant and variant.get('source'):
  source=variant['source'];argv+=['--speculation',source,'--draft-depth',str(variant['depth']),'--spec-policy',variant['policy']]
  if source=='mtp':argv+=['--mtp-prime-batch',str(variant['prime']), '--mtp-routed-stage','/local/glm53f-mtp-routed-52159552','--mtp-shared-stage','/local/glm53f-mtp-shared-52159552']
 if state:argv+=['--decode-state-check',str(out/(label+'.state'))]
 env=dict(os.environ,GLM53F_BIN_DIR=str(directory),GLM53F_RUN_TAG='router-eight-'+label,
          GLM53F_BENCH_SOURCE_REV=summary['binary_sha256']['frozen' if baseline is True else 'score_v3' if baseline == 'score-v3' else 'candidate'])
 with (out/(label+'.log')).open('x') as stream:
  stream.write('MTP_BATCH_CONFIG '+json.dumps({'argv':argv,'variant':variant,'state':state,'baseline':baseline})+'\n');stream.flush()
  subprocess.run(argv,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 text=(out/(label+'.log')).read_text()
 trials=[json.loads(s) for s in re.findall(r'GLM53F_BENCH_TRIAL (\{[^\n]+\})',text)]
 completed=[json.loads(s) for s in re.findall(r'GLM53F_BENCH_COMPLETE (\{[^\n]+\})',text)]
 assert len(completed)==1 and completed[0]['status']=='PASS' and completed[0]['repetitions']==repetitions
 assert len(trials)==repetitions and [t['trial'] for t in trials]==list(range(repetitions))
 count=len(Path(prompt).read_text().split())
 assert all(t['tokens_equal'] and t['prompt_tokens']==count and t['decode_transitions']==transitions and t['minimum_available_kb']>=2*1024*1024 for t in trials)
 ids=[int(x) for x in (out/(label+'.ids')).read_text().split()]
 assert len(ids)==transitions+1 and all(0<=x<154880 for x in ids)
 if state:assert len(re.findall(r'GLM53F_BENCH_STATE .*state=BIT_EXACT PASS',text))==repetitions+1
 result={'prefill':statistics.median(t['prefill_tok_s'] for t in trials),'decode':statistics.median(t['decode_tok_s'] for t in trials),
         'trials':trials,'ids':ids,'variant':variant,'mtp_stats':[json.loads(s) for s in re.findall(r'GLM53F_BENCH_MTP (\{[^\n]+\})',text)],
         'lookup_stats':[json.loads(s) for s in re.findall(r'GLM53F_BENCH_SPEC (\{[^\n]+\})',text)]}
 summary.setdefault('runs',{})[label]=result;save();print('MTP_BATCH_RUN',label,json.dumps({'prefill':result['prefill'],'decode':result['decode']}),flush=True)
 return result
def equal(a,b):assert a['ids']==b['ids'],'generated IDs differ from frozen baseline'


selected=json.loads((logs/'selected-native.json').read_text())
summary['native_selection']=selected
summary.update(prefill_includes_mtp_teacher_forcing=False,comparison='same candidate binary, only four-token router team scheduling differs',plain_pairs=[])
try:
 short=out/'short128.prompt.ids';short.write_text('\n'.join((root/'tmp/prompt8k.ids').read_text().split()[:128])+'\n')
 for prefix,prompt in [('short128-state',str(short)),('full-state','tmp/prompt8k.ids')]:
  a=run(prefix+'-legacy',prompt=prompt,transitions=128,repetitions=1,state=True)
  b=run(prefix+'-tiles4',{'router_tiles':True},prompt=prompt,transitions=128,repetitions=1,state=True);equal(a,b)
 frozen_control=run('frozen-control',baseline=True)
 a=run('legacy-screen');equal(a,frozen_control)
 b=run('tiles4-screen',{'router_tiles':True});equal(b,frozen_control)
 summary['screen_ratios']={k:b[k]/a[k] for k in ('prefill','decode')};save()
 for pair in range(5):
  results={}
  for mode in ((0,1) if pair%2==0 else (1,0)):
   results[mode]=run('plain-pair-{}-{}'.format(pair,mode),{'router_tiles':True} if mode else None,repetitions=1)
   equal(results[mode],frozen_control)
  summary['plain_pairs'].append({'pair':pair,**{k:results[1][k]/results[0][k] for k in ('prefill','decode')}});save()
 summary['plain_ratios']={k:statistics.median(x[k] for x in summary['plain_pairs']) for k in ('prefill','decode')}
 summary['status']='router_model_confirmation_complete';save()
 print('ROUTER_TILES_MODEL_COMPLETE',json.dumps(summary['plain_ratios']),flush=True)
except Exception as exc:
 summary.update(status='failed',error=repr(exc));save();raise
